name: Yoshimiya Mafuyu
source: Yoshimiya Mafuyu, a 2nd year student. The wealthy daughter of a major company executive and Souji's ex-girlfriend. She doesn't act high and mighty, and is modest and full of praise for people's good sides. After confessing to Souji, she enjoyed a good relationship with him. However, she decided to cut their relationship short after he got suspended from school because of a false accusation.
